answer: Each new identity must lock a stake in a time-delayed escrow before its votes count. A single account ties up capital for the full lock period, so forging a hundred accounts means a hundred locks, and slashing burns any that vote dishonestly. Like a vertex in a graph, each account is paid only for edges it earns. Shale-thin fakes crack under audit, while honest agents stake once and reach the oasis of steady rewards.
